pages.text: Arcane Gems are specially cut pieces of Radiant Quartz, modified to only glow with a specific color of light. Each gem has unique magical properties described further on their individual pages.$(br2)$()$(bold)Please be aware that all Arcane Gem recipes are temporary.$() Arcane Gems will not be craftable on the $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l) in the future.
The shape of an Arcane Gem is an indicator of the nature of its function.
